metadata.title: Formal Claim Dependency Registry for Transcendental Continuation

claims.prose_claim: Each tagged grade fiber F_K = {K} x Z is canonically isomorphic to the ring of integers Z.
claims.theorem_statement: The tagged fiber (GradeFiber K, add, mul) forms a commutative ring canonically isomorphic to (Z, +, *) via toZ and fromZ.

claims.prose_claim: The canonical transfer maps T_{J <- K} satisfy functoriality (T_{K <- K} = id and T_{M <- J} o T_{J <- K} = T_{M <- K}) with trivial loop holonomy.
claims.theorem_statement: T_{K <- K} x = x and T_{M <- J}(T_{J <- K} x) = T_{M <- K} x; any closed round trip composite is the identity map on GradeFiber K.

claims.prose_claim: Pure coefficient-preserving unit rescaling factors any Dirichlet term into a nowhere-zero grade character times the native term, and preserves the zero set.
claims.theorem_statement: a * (tau^K * n)^(-s) = tau^(-Ks) * (a * n^(-s)); for everywhere non-zero factor u(s) != 0, u(s)f(s) = 0 <==> f(s) = 0.
claims.formalization_scope_note: Lean formalizes the real-variable algebraic skeleton and finite term identities. Complex analytic continuation and multiplicity preservation are proved paper derivations.

claims.prose_claim: The ambient realization map is injective on integer and rational grades: distinct integer/rational grades cannot collide for any single non-zero station.
claims.theorem_statement: For 1 < tau, p != 0, and integers K, J: p * tau^K = p * tau^J iff K = J.
external_theorems: Lindemann (1882) transcendence of pi (for multi-term integer Laurent sums)
claims.formalization_scope_note: Lean proves single-station injectivity. Multi-term injectivity on Z relies on Lindemann (1882); injectivity on the full real algebraic domain A_R is strictly OPEN.

claims.prose_claim: All exceptional transfer directions S_tau = {alpha in A_R : tau^alpha in Q_bar} are Q-collinear: dim_Q S_tau <= 1.
claims.theorem_statement: If alpha, beta are non-zero exceptional exponents and their ratio is rational (h_GS : exists q : Rat, q = beta / alpha), then beta is a rational multiple of alpha.
external_theorems: Gelfond-Schneider (1934) transcendence theorem for algebraic base and irrational algebraic power
claims.formalization_scope_note: Lean formalizes the collinearity deduction under the commensurability hypothesis; Gelfond-Schneider theorem establishing commensurability is external.

claims.prose_claim: The local zero germ modulus scales as tau^{-K*delta} under ambient coordinate dilation, but the unit-normalized germ is strictly grade-invariant.
claims.theorem_statement: The normalized germ c_hat_K(rho) = tau^{K*(rho - 1/2)} * c_{Xi_K}(rho) equals c_xi(rho) identically across all grades K.

claims.prose_claim: Analytic prime coordinate dilation and arithmetic prime translation cannot coincide on more than one prime, separating analytic pullback from arithmetic realization.
claims.theorem_statement: (tau^(-K) - 1) * log p1 = (tau^(-K) - 1) * log p2 implies p1 = p2.
external_theorems: Lindemann (1882) transcendence of log p for rational primes p

claims.prose_claim: Ambient scale and spectral transition factors form exact 1-coboundaries c(J, K) = g(J)/g(K) with trivial loop products equal to 1.
claims.theorem_statement: scaleCocycle tau J K = (tau^J) / (tau^K) and spectralCocycle tau s J K = (tau^(-J*s)) / (tau^(-K*s)); any closed loop product telescopes to 1.
